EatFoodRation.name: EatFoodRation
steps: retrieve food ration from backpack
find comfortable safe spot in clearing
consume ration steadily
monitor for satiety

DrinkStoredWater.name: DrinkStoredWater
steps: inspect water bottle for remaining content
unscrew cap and drink slowly
stop when thirst lessens or bottle is empty

FindRestSpotAndNap.name: FindRestSpotAndNap
steps: locate a safe, sheltered rest spot
put on jacket for warmth if needed
lay down or relax and attempt to nap
remain alert to surroundings

ForageSeasonalBerries.name: ForageSeasonalBerries
steps: search for ripe berries in patch
identify safe edible berries by color/shape
collect and eat handfuls as found
avoid over-harvesting from one plant

PlanMorningActions.name: PlanMorningActions
steps: sit down and assess current priorities
list immediate needs and opportunities
sketch a simple plan in notebook
decide which direction/time-sensitive actions to take

InventorySupplies.name: InventorySupplies
steps: remove items from backpack one at a time
inspect each item for condition or loss
note food and water remaining
replace items in organized fashion

SetUpTemporaryCamp.name: SetUpTemporaryCamp
steps: identify safe, flat site for base
clear small area of hazards
arrange backpack and jacket for comfort
set visible markers for personal site

ScoutForExits.name: ScoutForExits
steps: move to forest edge for broadest view
scan area for possible trails or breaks
mark possible exit points on notebook sketch
select one for closer investigation

FollowOldPathway.name: FollowOldPathway
steps: locate starting point of visible path
walk slowly, staying alert to hazards
note any landmarks for later return
evaluate if path leads closer to way out

NavigateViaLandmarks.name: NavigateViaLandmarks
steps: identify prominent landmarks (trees, boulders, sun)
sketch approximate map in notebook
use sun position to maintain correct heading
adjust course to stay on path toward chosen exit

SignalForHelp.name: SignalForHelp
steps: move to clear, visible spot
wave jacket or bright clothing to sky
arrange items on ground as signal
return to check signals periodically

MarkTrailWithBranches.name: MarkTrailWithBranches
steps: collect distinctive fallen branches
place branches at intervals along path taken
use MultiTool to notch or shape markers
note branch markers in notebook

CareForUnknownStranger.name: CareForUnknownStranger
steps: approach stranger with caution
offer water or food if situation demands
observe for signs of distress
remain non-threatening and await response

MaintainJournal.name: MaintainJournal
steps: review events of the day in memory
record new discoveries and hazards
sketch changes to landscape or feelings
note ideas for next day's actions

PracticeOrientationSkills.name: PracticeOrientationSkills
steps: face sun and estimate time of day
compare notes to real sun movement
test navigation using shadow direction
log accuracy of self-calculated bearings

ReviewSurvivalNotes.name: ReviewSurvivalNotes
steps: go through prior entries in the notebook
refresh survival priorities and hazards
mentally rehearse routines
adjust behavior for next chance

ReflectOnSituation.name: ReflectOnSituation
steps: find quiet place removed from distraction
think about what led to current predicament
explore internal feelings and needs
articulate hopes for rescue or escape

MentallyMapArea.name: MentallyMapArea
steps: visualize explored routes and features
mentally note locations of hazards and food
add imagined connections between points
plan areas to check tomorrow

SimpleGameOrPuzzle.name: SimpleGameOrPuzzle
steps: invent a quick math or logic puzzle
draw patterns or mazes in notebook
complete without referencing solutions
reward self with snack or break

NatureObservationBreak.name: NatureObservationBreak
steps: find peaceful spot with good visibility
quietly observe birds or small animals
try sketching interesting flora or fauna
note any new potential hazards or food

IdlyThrowRocks.name: IdlyThrowRocks
steps: collect handful of small rocks
throw them at distant targets for fun
watch for patterns or distractions
stop if tired or something more urgent comes up

ScanForPhysicalHazards.name: ScanForPhysicalHazards
steps: survey area for uneven ground or sharp objects
note places to avoid
mark major hazards in notebook
adjust walking routes accordingly

HideIfThreatPerceived.name: HideIfThreatPerceived
steps: listen for unfamiliar sounds
if threat detected, move quietly to cover
conceal self using thicket or cave interior
remain silent until confident of safety

CreateEmergencyRockSignal.name: CreateEmergencyRockSignal
steps: collect flat rocks or sticks
arrange in large visible pattern (SOS, arrow)
ensure signal can be seen from air
check occasionally to repair disturbances

StretchAndExercise.name: StretchAndExercise
steps: perform gentle stretching routine
loosen muscles from sleeping on rough ground
do a few bodyweight movements as tolerated
relax and monitor physical state

InspectAndCleanSmallWounds.name: InspectAndCleanSmallWounds
steps: inspect body for cuts or scrapes
clean wounds with clean water
use MultiTool tweezers for debris
let wounds air dry if possible

ManageSunExposure.name: ManageSunExposure
steps: move to shaded area during peak sun
wear jacket for extra UV protection if in sun
limit time in direct sunlight
rest and hydrate if overheated

RefillWaterBottleAtSpring.name: RefillWaterBottleAtSpring
steps: travel to known spring location
fill water bottle from clear flowing water
inspect water for visible debris
secure bottle cap and return to camp

RepairClothingOrGear.name: RepairClothingOrGear
steps: inspect jacket and gear for rips or damage
use MultiTool or found stick to patch/secure
tie off loose threads or straps
test repairs by light activity

OrganizeCampArea.name: OrganizeCampArea
steps: tidy up sleeping/rest area
collect and dispose of trash safely
group tools or food for easy access
clear branches or obstacles for safe night

InitiateAwkwardGreeting.name: InitiateAwkwardGreeting
steps: approach unknown stranger with visible hands
offer informal greeting (wave, 'uh, hey')
watch for response and adjust approach
maintain healthy distance unless invited closer
